item.title: Canada fast-tracking oil pipeline designed to diversify economy away from US
item.description: Canada will fast track the approval process for a new proposed crude oil export pipeline to its west coast that could generate over C$20 billion (US$14 billion) a year in GDP, Prime Minister ‌Mark Carney said on Thursday. The pipeline, which was announced in July, is a crucial part of Carney’s bid to diversify the economy away from the United States and help lessen the effect of US President Donald Trump’s tariffs. Carney said Ottawa would officially list the Pacific Link pipeline as a project... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: UK-Iranian Man Arrested in Connection to RAF Fairford Air Base Incident
item.description: A UK-Iranian dual national was arrested in London over a security incident linked to RAF Fairford. The incident followed the arrest of five British men suspected of preparing a terrorist act. Authorities are investigating potential foreign state involvement, particularly from Iran, which has denied any connection. UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham has indicated strong signs suggesting Iran's role in the incident. Publicado también por: The Times of India - World. Fuente: The New York Times - World.

item.title: Las protestas estudiantiles ponen en aprietos al Gobierno francés
item.description: El Gobierno francés se enfrenta a un nuevo frente social que no había visto venir. Las protestas de los estudiantes de secundaria no han parado de crecer a lo largo de esta semana y han dejado numerosas imágenes de violencia urbana. La apuesta del primer ministro, Sébastien Lecornu, de responder con la intervención de los antidisturbios al más mínimo incidente delante de los institutos ha acentuado la rabia de los adolescentes y los jóvenes.Después de que estas manifestaciones empezaran a finales de la semana pasada en establecimientos de ciudades modestas de la periferia de París, este… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.

item.title: ‘Total class act’: Marie-France van Heel is poised to be a very different PM’s wife
item.description: The former marketing executive is expected to play a big role in promoting the UK and could be the most influential spouse in No 10 in years Sarah Brown called Gordon her hero , Samantha Cameron insisted David was “incredibly funny” , while Akshata Murty said Rishi was her best friend . When Marie-France van Heel spoke about her husband, Andy Burnham, in a rare public interview a decade ago, she joked that she had noticed his “good looks … and monobrow”. The spousal humanising of a party leader is a well-worn political tool, but van Heel is likely to be a very different prime ministerial… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Bolivia detiene al fiscal general Roger Mariaca por presuntos vínculos con el narcotráfico: ABC del caso
item.description: El fiscal general de Bolivia, Roger Mariaca, fue detenido en Santa Cruz, acusado por el Gobierno de presuntamente encabezar una organización criminal que operaba dentro del Ministerio Público para proteger actividades de narcotráfico. El arresto se produjo dos días después de que Estados Unidos le revocara el visado por supuestos sobornos y coincide con un acercamiento entre el país latinoamericano y Washington en materia de seguridad. Mariaca ha rechazado las acusaciones y denunciado motivaciones políticas. Entretanto, la Fiscalía designó a Luis Montaño como responsable interino para… Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: France school protests escalate into ‘urban violence’ as PM calls crisis cabinet meeting
item.description: About 900 demonstrations, blockades and related incidents under way outside high schools around the country A fast-growing protest by high-school students over long hours, teacher shortages and decaying facilities has escalated into “urban violence”, the French government has warned, as it said many schools would switch to online classes to protect teachers and pupils. The prime minister, Sébastien Lecornu, called a crisis cabinet meeting on Thursday and told ministers to cancel travel plans to deal with the demonstrations, which erupted in the Paris region last week but have snowballed… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.description: Como en todas las elecciones, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva y Flávio Bolsonaro buscan conquistar a los sectores religiosos de Brasil para fortalecer sus posibilidades de llegar a la Presidencia. item.title: Francia intenta contener su deuda y déficit con recortes, mientras incumple los límites de la UE
item.description: El Gobierno francés presentó este jueves 1 de octubre su proyecto de presupuesto para 2027, con un plan de ajuste de 43.000 millones de euros mediante recortes de gasto y mayores ingresos tributarios. La Administración del primer ministro Sébastien Lecornu afronta un déficit previsto del 5,4% del PIB en 2026 y una deuda pública que podría alcanzar el 121,7% del PIB en 2027, muy por encima de los límites de la Unión Europea. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Teens block high schools across France, demand better conditions
item.description: France's prime minister convened a crisis meeting on Thursday and canceled ministers' trips to focus on the nationwide spread of protests, some violent, by high school students venting against under-resourced schools, long hours and other complaints. The demonstrations erupted in Paris-region schools last week and have snowballed, with police making hundreds of arrests in clashes with the young protesters. FRANCE 24's International Affairs Editor Angela Diffley tells us more. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Estudiantes endurecen los bloqueos en Francia: rocían con gasolina al director de una escuela
item.description: En lo que fue calificado como un "segundo acto" de la protesta, el Sindicato de Estudiantes reivindicó este jueves 1 de octubre una treintena de bloqueos en campus universitarios, que se suman al más de un centenar de establecimientos escolares afectados por las manifestaciones, que reclaman mejores condiciones laborales y de infraestructura. Las autoridades reportaron decenas de incidentes violentos en torno a las protestas y el primer ministro Sébastien Lecornu convocó una reunión de crisis. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Amazon acaba de renovar toda su gama Kindle. La pantalla cambia por fuera y la batería, por obligación europea
item.description: Los Kindle tienen una particularidad que no comparten muchos de los dispositivos que usamos a diario: envejecen despacio. Podemos cambiar de móvil, de auriculares o incluso de ordenador mientras el mismo lector electrónico sigue cumpliendo exactamente con lo que le pedimos. Amazon renovó Kindle y Paperwhite en 2024 y aquel mismo año estrenó Colorsoft, su primer Kindle a color . Ahora, dos años después, vuelve sobre los tres modelos a la vez. Y eso hace especialmente interesante mirar qué ha cambiado esta vez. La respuesta empieza, literalmente, en la pantalla. Amazon asegura haber rediseñado… Fuente: Xataka.
item.dc:creator: Javier Marquez

item.title: Brasil: la crisis económica que pone a prueba a Lula en Foz do Iguaçu
item.description: La desaceleración económica y la crisis comercial golpean a Foz do Iguaçu, ciudad brasileña fronteriza con Paraguay y Argentina cuya economía depende en buena medida del turismo y de la actividad vinculada a la central hidroeléctrica de Itaipú. El deterioro económico añade presión sobre el presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva de cara a las elecciones, en una localidad donde Jair Bolsonaro obtuvo mayor respaldo en 2022. ¿Puede el malestar económico influir en el voto y convertirse en un desafío para el oficialismo? Reportaje de Valeria Saccone y Fanny Lothaire para France 24. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: Valeria Saccone

item.title: A blessing or a curse? New Caledonia's dwindling nickel industry
item.description: This Thursday October 1, the French government is holding a summit aimed at attracting investors and revitalising wealth creation in France's overseas territories. Among the assets Paris wants to highlight is New Caledonian nickel. But the industry has been severely weakened by the political deadlock and tensions that have rocked the archipelago in recent years. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.description: Police investigating reports of politicians’ homes being broken into in last year with nothing being stolen The Finnish prime minister, Petteri Orpo, has said a foreign power could be responsible for a series of suspected break-ins at the homes of several members of parliament. Police said on Thursday they were investigating multiple reports of MPs’ homes being broken into in the Helsinki area in the last year in which nothing was stolen but subtle signs of breaking and entering were left. item.title: UK, France end 'on in, one out' Channel migrant exchange deal
item.description: A year-old deal between France and Britain to return migrants crossing the Channel illegally on small boats has come to an end, the UK interior ministry said Wednesday. The deal was agreed under former UK prime minister Keir Starmer last year in a bid to help a post-Brexit reset by easing what had become a major source of tension between the neighbours. item.title: France demands belt-tightening in 2027 budget as investors sour on its debt
item.description: France presented its ​2027 budget bill on Thursday, seeking to enact unpopular belt-tightening measures that can lower its deficit and appease increasingly twitchy bond investors ahead of next year's presidential election. The legislation faces a tough ride in a deeply divided parliament, as political clans position themselves for one of the country's most consequential elections in modern times. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Brazil elections: Can Lula’s anti-poverty record win over voters?
item.description: In Brazil, incumbent President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is seeking a fourth and final term in the presidential election on October 4. In 2022, he made the fight against hunger and poverty a key campaign promise. Between 2023 and 2024, nearly nine million people were lifted out of poverty thanks to the government’s social and economic programs. The decline was particularly sharp in Brazil’s Northeast. A traditional stronghold for Lula, will the progress made in reducing poverty translate into stronger support for the current president? FRANCE 24's team on the ground reports. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.description: El Reino Unido informó el miércoles de que había terminado un acuerdo de devolución de migrantes con Francia, vigente desde hacía un año y destinado a frenar la llegada de personas que cruzan el Canal de la Mancha en pequeñas embarcaciones.«El programa piloto del gobierno con Francia para devolver a solicitantes de asilo a cambio de un número equivalente de migrantes que puedan entrar legalmente ya no está procesando nuevos casos», declaró el Ministerio del Interior, confirmando el fin del denominado acuerdo «uno entra, uno sale» , puesto en marcha en agosto y cuya vigencia estaba prevista… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.

item.title: Trump claims he discussed release of political prisoners in China with Xi at summit
item.description: US President Donald Trump said on Wednesday that he discussed the release of political prisoners in China with his counterpart, Xi Jinping, in Washington last week. “We talked, and I think we had some very, very important discussions. Hopefully fruitful discussions,” Trump told reporters in the White House. Families had stepped up pressure on the Trump administration to push Beijing to release their loved ones ahead of Xi’s three-day state visit. Trump was asked whether he had raised the cases... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
